import cadquery as cq
result = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .cylinder(11.4, 32.8)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(21.3)
    .extrude(48.8)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(9.4)
    .extrude(29.4)
    .faces(">Z").workplane()
    .circle(7.1)
    .extrude(6.9)
    .faces(">Z")
    .chamfer(1.5)
    .faces("<Z")
    .faces("<Z").workplane()
    .hole(4.9)
)
result = result.cut(
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .pushPoints([(0, 25 - 11.4 / 2), (0, 45 - 11.4 / 2)])
    .circle(4)
    .extrude(40, both=True)
)
show_object(result)
